title: Evaluation evidence (eval.json)
description: Written by the autonomous loop's evaluate stage, consumed by its gate and by the release builder. Binds measured results to exact weights (docs/TRAINING_ja.md#evaluation).

checkpoint.description: where the evaluated checkpoint lived (informational; never copied into releases)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the evaluation

protocol.description: Games per opponent, seat rotation, limits, opening_plies, opening_seed and sample_unit=opening_actions_and_seating. Grouping excludes deal seeds. Raw wins/losses/draws remain reported.

score_rate.description: Raw (wins + 0.5 draws) / games. The gate score and Wilson bound use equal-weight group means from extra when present.

ci_low.description: Wilson 95% bound on sum of group mean scores / effective_games when extra sample metadata exists. Legacy files without it retain their historical raw interval for reading; gates conservatively credit at most two legacy seatings.

ci_high.description: Wilson 95% bound on sum of group mean scores / effective_games when extra sample metadata exists. Legacy files without it retain their historical raw interval for reading; gates conservatively credit at most two legacy seatings.

distinct_games.description: Distinct complete joint action sequences including the opening and seat assignment; deal seed is excluded.

distinct_openings.description: Distinct opening joint action sequences; zero opening plies yields one empty opening when games were played.

effective_games.description: Number of (opening actions, seating) groups; zero opening plies with two seatings yields n=2 regardless of raw game count.

effective_successes.description: Sum of group mean scores. Each game scores win=1, loss=0, draw or separately reported truncation=0.5. Wilson uses this sum over effective_games, not raw counts.
